%component.seq

component.seq (component sequence for general combined base) defines a sequence of components as needed in the general base tag set, allowing components from any base to be used, but preventing their mixing.
Note

When used in a content model, this entity, like other entities with names of the form ‘x.seq’, allows zero or more occurrences of its content to occur.
Declaration <!ENTITY % component.seq '(%m.common;)*, (%gen.verse; %gen.drama; %gen.spoken; %gen.dictionaries; %gen.terminology; TEI...end)?' >
